company.name: MaintainX
company.shortDescription: MaintainX provides a CMMS/EAM platform that leverages AI to enhance asset performance and reduce downtime for industrial teams.
company.description: MaintainX is a software company that provides maintenance and asset management tools for industrial and frontline operations. Its platform helps organizations manage work orders, preventive maintenance, inspections, reporting, asset tracking, and parts inventory through a centralized digital system. The company integrates AI-powered features that assist teams with troubleshooting, data collection, operational analysis, and predictive maintenance workflows. MaintainX is used across industries such as manufacturing, facilities management, food and beverage, retail, and distribution to improve equipment uptime and streamline maintenance processes. The platform also supports compliance and safety procedures by digitizing workflows and standardizing maintenance operations across multiple sites.

aiResearchSummary.text: MaintainX is researching systems for detection and prevention of equipment failure using multiple agents that ingest state data from many sources to predict faults and avoid downtime. It is also developing an LLM agent that generates a standardized data model from non standardized asset metadata and exposes it via APIs, along with methods for propagating authored packages and digital twins to asset management platforms. Together these efforts target equipment health, data standardization, and asset integration.
